newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mainly firmer, fuel oil barges of.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mainly firmer, fuel oil barges of.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firmer on Friday, traders said.
Gas oil firmed slightly with IPE futures but thin demand helped keep pressure on heating oil and diesel premiums.
Naphtha prices were steady to higher but physical markets were quiet with October business completed. Some demand for heavy grades to make gasoline was noted.

Gasoline firmed with a rally in Brent and tight high octane supply. Nov swaps traded at $225.50 and $226.50, up $3. Dec swaps rose $4 to $212. Fuel oil barges were lower at $113-114 fob ARA, but cargoes held at $110-112.
